answer: The window charges 160 stamped dockets, each costing $68 to have checked before it opens, and the dawn is that the fee never comes back. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. No Flagonbound champagne factor cork writ, no seat: the rule is plain, and a writ champagne factors sign after wine office audits is why it holds. The island is on the docket. One ember, one entry.
